issue.title: Escalation banner stays visible after the HITL issue is resolved
issue.body:
## Summary

The dashboard's red escalation banner keeps reading "1 issue awaiting human
input" after the underlying HITL issue has been resolved. It only clears on a
hard page reload, so operators watching the board believe the queue is blocked
when it is not.

## Reproduction

1. Label an open issue `hydraflow-hitl` and wait for `HITLRunner` to post its
   question comment (about 30s on the sandbox fleet).
2. Open the run dashboard at `/dashboard`. The escalation banner appears with a
   link to the issue.
3. Answer the question in the issue thread and remove the `hydraflow-hitl`
   label so the issue leaves the escalation set.
4. Watch the banner for two minutes without reloading.

## Expected

The banner disappears within one poll interval (5s) of the issue leaving the
escalation set, and `GET /api/escalations` no longer lists it.

## Observed

`GET /api/escalations` correctly returns `[]` once the label is removed, so the
API side is fine. The front end keeps rendering the last non-empty payload
because `renderEscalations()` early-returns when the list is empty instead of
clearing the container. Separately, `HITLRunner.reconcile_escalations()` only
ever adds to `self._escalations` — resolved issues stay in the in-memory set
until the process restarts, so a fleet restart is currently the only way to get
a correct count from a long-running orchestrator.

## Affected

- `src/hitl_runner.py` — `reconcile_escalations()` never removes entries
- `web/api.py` — `/api/escalations` returns 204 with no body when the set is
  empty, which the front end treats as "no update"
- `web/static/js/dashboard.js` — `renderEscalations()` early-return
- No regression coverage in `tests/test_hitl_runner.py`

## Notes

Reported twice in one week by the on-call rotation. Second report included a
screenshot of a banner citing issue #4610, which had been closed for six days.

args.diff_summary:
src/hitl_runner.py               | 38 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++-----
 web/api.py                       |  6 ++++--
 web/static/js/dashboard.js       | 14 ++++++++++---
 tests/test_hitl_runner.py        | 38 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 tests/test_web_api.py            |  9 +++++++++
 5 files changed, 92 insertions(+), 13 deletions(-)

Key changes:
- src/hitl_runner.py: reconcile_escalations() now diffs the live label set in
  both directions and deletes resolved entries; publishes one
  ESCALATION_RESOLVED event per poll carrying the sorted removed issue numbers.
- web/api.py: GET /api/escalations returns JSONResponse([]) with status 200 on
  an empty set instead of a bare 204.
- web/static/js/dashboard.js: renderEscalations() clears the list container and
  hides the banner on an empty payload; toggles aria-live with visibility.
- tests: two new HITLRunner regression tests (removal + idempotence) and one
  web API test asserting the 200/empty-array contract.
